rule: Manufacturer datasheet properties are screening evidence only. Brickmen production approval requires physical connector, force, cycle, dimensional and aging validation on the actual machine/process.

candidates.name: TGM-7
special_notes: Manufacturer positions material specifically for functional tabletop miniatures.
2026 printing guide says non-clear color variants can be blended while retaining common print settings.
High published 24h water absorption makes dimensional/retention aging a specific Brickmen test item.
Manufacturer guide says not compatible with laser-based Formlabs systems; treat as MSLA/DLP candidate.

candidates.name: Blu Tough
special_notes: Engineering resin intended to balance hardness and impact resistance.
Good baseline for a relatively stiff tough accessory.

candidates.name: Blu Nylon Black
special_notes: More elongation than regular Blu with similar stiffness range.
Candidate for rigid-but-less-brittle connectors.

candidates.name: Tenacious Clear / Obsidian Black
special_notes: Manufacturer explicitly supports use alone or blending with other 405nm resins to enhance impact resistance.
Any blend becomes a new Brickmen material profile and must be recalibrated.
Community miniature reports commonly discuss roughly 10-20% Tenacious blends, but those ratios are only experiment starting points.

candidates.name: Tough 1500 Resin V2
special_notes: Manufacturer positions material as polypropylene-like and suitable for compliant mechanisms/latches/snap fits.
Properties cited are process-specific: Form 4 / defined settings / defined Form Cure V2 cycle.
High-value reference candidate for professional automation path.

candidates.name: Tough 2000 Resin V2
special_notes: Manufacturer positions stiffness similarly to ABS while remaining far more elongating than cited extruded ABS comparison.
Tough 1500 is the more obvious compliant/snap-fit candidate; Tough 2000 is the stiffer candidate.
Properties are process/cure specific.

candidates.name: ABS-Like Resin Pro 2
special_notes: Low-cost candidate with unusually high supplier-listed Izod impact value; verify test conditions and Brickmen physical performance rather than comparing that number directly across vendors.
Supplier publishes explicit wash/cure ranges that should be captured in a material profile.

candidates.name: ABS-Like Resin V3.0
special_notes: Manufacturer emphasizes impact resistance, low shrinkage and fine-detail use but the reviewed product page does not expose a complete comparable mechanical-property table.
Useful economical baseline; obtain/retain the exact TDS for any selected lot before production approval.

candidates.name: Color Kit / Color Base
special_notes: CMYKW pigment system with documented recipes enables color-through-part production.
Post-cured 6% elongation is much lower than the tough-resin candidates; do not default to it for thin hand-held accessories merely to avoid painting.
Treat color match and mechanical profile as a coupled manufacturing decision.

proposed_first_experiment_matrix: Siraya Blu Tough or Blu Nylon Black
Anycubic ABS-Like Resin Pro 2 or ELEGOO ABS-Like V3 as a low-cost baseline
One validated base resin plus Siraya Tenacious experimental blend ladder
Professional reference material only if/when a Form 4-class system is available
